Events

Maths tools

Calculate: he works the figure out. Build: he chooses the two figures and the sign; the model then works it out. Model: the airline's software works it out. Each tool has a default for each stage of the story; a change shows on the next screen.

Practice questions after the day's sums (the workings page, the pupil's own numbers)

Sign-offs a week

From week 2 the pupil calculates at most this many sums a week (HandSumRules 9): the most instructive first; the rest are Build (he picks the figures and the operation) or the model's. A relationship is Calculate twice, then Build for a new instance (rule 10). Month ends bring a Finance audit, or a board review when the plan has not changed all month (rule 11).

Pupil record

Every sign-off and review step, with the working as it was typed, and each week's decisions (D75). Print it by date or by kind of maths, for a week, a chapter or everything.

Chapters 2–6: the gates

Read from the workbook, not yet built: dates that switch things on, the challenges and hunts to come.

By hand so far

The hand-sum rules (workbook HandSumRules 1–6) decide what the pupil works out each day; the Maths tools levels above override them.
